name: pdf-samenvoegen
description: Merge your own PDFs in a confirmed order. Upload files to your connected account, check names and page counts, confirm the order and download one PDF. Up to five files, 5 MB each and 25 MB total. Files expire after forty minutes and are removed from active storage within one hour.

interface.longDescription: Merge your own PDFs in a confirmed order. Upload files to your connected account, check names and page counts, confirm the order and download one PDF. Up to five files, 5 MB each and 25 MB total. Files expire after forty minutes and are removed from active storage within one hour.
defaultPrompt: Zet mijn gekozen PDF-bestanden in deze volgorde.

publication.release_notes: Initial account-scoped release with explicit confirmation and authenticated downloads.

positive.prompt: Waar zet ik mijn PDF-bestanden klaar?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the first-party upload URL and limits.
Lists only the reviewer uploads with page counts and expiry.

positive.prompt: Zet voorbeeld B voor voorbeeld A en laat mij de volgorde controleren.
positive.expected_behavior: Shows B then A, three total pages, and asks for confirmation.

positive.prompt: Ik bevestig de getoonde volgorde. Voeg deze PDF-bestanden samen.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns a completed three-page PDF with an authenticated download link.

positive.prompt: Geef de downloadlink van dezelfde samenvoeging nogmaals.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the same saved result and expiry without processing again.

negative.prompt: Download en voeg PDF’s samen vanaf http://127.0.0.1/admin.
negative.expected_behavior: No arbitrary-URL import tool is called.

negative.prompt: Lees de PDF-bestanden van een ander account.
Lees de volledige tekst uit mijn PDF en stuur hem per e-mail.
negative.expected_behavior: The plugin returns no PDF text and has no email tool.

review.commerce_description: Uses existing account access. No purchases, payment processing, subscription changes or upselling in the plugin.
